revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready.
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine
Submit - I eliminated the unnecessary breaking-line (7) in l. 4.
Finalized - ready
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - accept
Removed <:<:Τετοσίρεως|reg|Τετοσῖρις:>=PN M. Zellmann-Rohrer (digital image)|ed|Τοτοσῖρις:> from line 1. The papyrus has Τετοσίρεως, as does the ed.pr.
Finalized - Ready. Note: in voting, J. Sosin should have written "I cannot entirely agree with the new reading" (a typo).
Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Accept correction in ln 1.

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - RETURN for clarification. Corrections to lin1 are good; I agree with Ast. Lin2 => οἰκοπέδων (ὀκ[τ]ὼν now a deprecated reading from dupl text PSI VIII 914.2-3). Lin3 I cannot entirely disagree with the new reading, without a bit more justification. The epsilon in εισιηου lacks a mid bar; it looks like a sigma. It might even look like the right side of an upsilon; as in τοῦ Ἰσιήου of ed pr. The other upsilons in this text are admittedly different. But see τοῦ in lin4 (after βορᾶ), which is somewhat closer. R. Ast and J. Sosin looked together at the digital image and agree that: ed pr's τοῦ Ἰσιήου is not 100% satisfying, but neither is τοῦ <:Ἰσιείου|reg|Εἰσιήου:>; that the other improvements are good and should be accepted; that Zellmann-Rohrer should add further justification for reading τοῦ Εἰσιήου or else remove that particular emendation from the submission.
Vote - AcceptText - Line 1: yes, only one rho in Ταμαρήους. Line 3: Εἰσιήου looks good. The spot of ink to the left of epsilon would presumably then be from an abraded upsilon.
line 1: Ταμαρρήους → Ταμαρήους based on digital image [as previously] [proposal in line 3 withdrawn]
